title: factdiff drop_citation loses the id of a DECISION or LOG part in the tag it rewrites
goal: drop_citation (_tools/factdiff.py) rewrites a tag part by part from kind, ids and note, so a DECISION or LOG part (its id is in part decision or log, ids empty) comes out as a bare kind with its id gone; it keeps those ids, and a test named drop_citation_keeps_decision_and_log_ids plants a tag with a source and a LOG or DECISION part

run:
import os,sys,tempfile; d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); os.makedirs(d+'/print'); open(d+'/_root.md','w').write('---
root: fixture
id_prefix: FXT
visibility: internal
description: x
---
'); open(d+'/print/queues.md','w').write('---
topic: print/queues
---

## Facts
- Jobs are kept 14 days. [DOC S1208, S1209; LOG L-aaaaaaaa]
'); os.environ['KB_ROOTS']=d; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import factdiff,kbcommon,kbfacts; factdiff.ROOT=kbcommon.root('fixture'); key=next(kbfacts.fact_key(u['text']) for u in kbfacts.units('fixture') if '14 days' in u['text']); factdiff.drop_citation('print/queues.md',key,'S1208','gone'); sys.exit(0 if 'LOG L-aaaaaaaa' in open(d+'/print/queues.md').read() else 1)
